lines.say: [gravelly] Marines would die for their Chapter. So why do these three wear it on ONE shoulder?
lines.text: MARINES WOULD DIE FOR THEIR CHAPTER. SO WHY DO THESE THREE WEAR IT ON ONE SHOULDER?

lines.say: [grim] Deathwatch. Marines lent out by their Chapters to hunt aliens for the Inquisition. Black armour. Silver left arm.
lines.text: DEATHWATCH. MARINES LENT OUT BY THEIR CHAPTERS TO HUNT ALIENS FOR THE INQUISITION. BLACK ARMOUR. SILVER LEFT ARM.

lines.say: [nervous] A Space Wolf, a Templar and a Blood Angel in ONE squad? Don't they hate each other?
lines.text: A SPACE WOLF, A TEMPLAR AND A BLOOD ANGEL IN ONE SQUAD? DON'T THEY HATE EACH OTHER?

lines.say: [gruff, amused] Only until the xenos show up.
lines.text: ONLY UNTIL THE XENOS SHOW UP.

lines.say: [stern] Purge the alien first. Argue later.
lines.text: PURGE THE ALIEN FIRST. ARGUE LATER.

lines.say: [tired, dry] We argue all the way there, little man. Every time.
lines.text: WE ARGUE ALL THE WAY THERE, LITTLE MAN. EVERY TIME.

lines.say: [quietly] And after the hunt, they go home?
lines.text: AND AFTER THE HUNT, THEY GO HOME?

lines.say: [gently] Some do. Others serve the Long Vigil until they die.
lines.text: SOME DO. OTHERS SERVE THE LONG VIGIL UNTIL THEY DIE.

lines.say: [quiet, heavy] Our Chapter keeps the right shoulder. The Watch keeps the rest.
lines.text: OUR CHAPTER KEEPS THE RIGHT SHOULDER. THE WATCH KEEPS THE REST.

lines.say: [softly] Half a Marine goes home, kid. The other half never leaves the Vigil.
lines.text: HALF A MARINE GOES HOME, KID. THE OTHER HALF NEVER LEAVES THE VIGIL.

hum: Low distant war drone and rumbling, ominous
zap: Distant explosion boom with ringing echo, short
puff: Man exhales a long puff of cigar smoke, slow breath
page: Comic book page turning quickly, paper whoosh
whoosh: Quick soft camera whoosh swipe transition
bell: Single distant church bell toll, slow, echoing

music: Slow dark gothic choir and low drone with a single tolling bell, grim, sparse, instrumental, no vocals, 65 bpm
